Part of the [first in-person Swedish Metabarcoding Network (SMN) meeting](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"}.

In this hands-on workshop, we explore metabarcoding data from raw sequencing reads to biodiversity patterns. We process reads into ASVs using [nf-core/ampliseq](https://nf-co.re/ampliseq){target="_blank"}, then analyse data from the [ASV portal](https://asv-portal.biodiversitydata.se/index){target="_blank"} in R with [asvoccur](https://github.com/biodiversitydata-se/asvoccur){target="_blank"} and [ecolongr](https://github.com/biodiversitydata-se/ecolongr){target="_blank"}. These tools are developed by, or with contributions from, the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"}.

## Programme

Wednesday 9 December 2026, Evolutionary Biology Centre (EBC), Uppsala

- **09:00–09:10** Introduction
- **09:10–10:30** From raw reads to ASVs with nf-core/ampliseq
- **10:30–11:00** Fika
- **11:00–12:45** Analyse data from the ASV portal in R — [Open the tutorial](tutorial.qmd)

## Instructors
- Dr. Tobias Andermann — SBDI & Uppsala University
- Prof. Anders Andersson — SBDI & KTH SciLifeLab
- Dr. Daniel Lundin — SBDI & Linnaeus University
- Dr. Maria Prager — SBDI & University of Gothenburg
